name: Major floods
summary: No major flood alerts; Cyclone Murasu to bring heavy rain to India's east coast
state: GDACS listed no orange or red flood alerts as of 05:40 UTC on 2 Nov. Cyclone Murasu is forecast to bring heavy rain and a storm surge of up to 1.5m to low-lying districts of Andhra Pradesh on 2–3 Nov.
for_you: No major flood disruption to travel at present; check local warnings in south-east India.

sources.title: GDACS — Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System
ETV Bharat — Cyclone Murasu live updates

why: Floods affect more people than any other hazard, displacing millions each year.
drivers: Extreme rainfall, monsoons, cyclones, snowmelt, dam failures.

rubric.alert: GDACS red flood alert, or > 100 deaths in a single event.
rubric.watch: GDACS orange flood alert, or a flood displacing > 50,000.
